## Checklist

- [ ] Tests run for what I changed (`ui_test`, `host_test`, `tools/i18n.py check`, `tools/devices.py check`) and the result is stated here
- [ ] Hardware behaviour was tested on a board, or I say clearly that it was not
- [ ] Documentation updated (spec, user guide) where behaviour changed
- [ ] No version history, dates or session notes in docs
- [ ] No personal data (real device addresses, WiFi names, passwords, own IPs)
- [ ] My contribution can be licensed as described in CONTRIBUTING.md
